caption:
🎃 SCHOOLHOUSE SHOCK · REDESIGN (scarier / Where's-Waldo) · 1/4 — THE WHOLE STATE
Dense nightmare panorama, dread under the cartoon. Abbott grown colossal at center, fire-eyed, a river of gold pouring from his lap across Texas to the donor's hand and the vault (lower left). Dozens of stone hands plucking schoolhouses, troopers on horseback, the lottery drum spilling kids onto a heap. Everything happening at once. This is the keystone / centerpiece.
No baked text, no flag — the Israel-money thread stays its own careful panel, not fused into the monster.

🎃 REDESIGN · 2/4 — THE HARVEST (the schools)
The strongest of the set. A whole countryside of little red schoolhouses being plucked up by dozens of giant stone government hands and stuffed into sacks, hundreds of tiny children screaming and fleeing below, grey officials on platforms directing the hands with pointers, the horizon on fire.
Receipt: 8 Texas districts have had their ELECTED boards replaced by state appointees — 4 of them in 2026 alone (Fort Worth, Lake Worth, Beaumont, Connally). Fort Worth's trigger campus was already closed; Houston's was passing.

🎃 REDESIGN · 3/4 — THE LOTTERY (the voucher)
A cavernous hall: the lottery drum stuffed with children, a lucky few through the golden door, the vast majority tumbling onto a mountain of the waitlisted. At left, a sorting gate waving kids in wheelchairs AWAY from the golden door while a filing cabinet spits out empty folders.
Receipt: 274,036 applied, ~96k awarded, 132,319 waitlisted outright. The Comptroller's own document: the program 'was unable to electronically confirm a current IEP,' so special-ed kids were demoted out of the only fully-funded tier. (One garble: booth reads 'SORTING' twice — would clean before print.)

🎃 REDESIGN · 4/4 — THE TROOPERS (Austin, on the record)
Night quad under the clock tower: a faceless wall of mounted state troopers with raised batons driving a scattering crowd of individual students, searchlights, everything burning. Journalists shoved back at the edge.
Receipt: April 2024, 100+ DPS troopers on UT-Austin at Abbott's direction, 57 (UT's president says 55) arrested — every charge dropped for lack of probable cause. Abbott demanded students be expelled; by UT's count nearly half arrested weren't students at all.
